levels.name: Beauty-Full
levels.description:
■ Activates upon reloading to max ammunition while in the Preparation for Change state. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Changes the weapon in use: Snipe Mode
Charge Time: 1 sec
Damage: 62.13% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK
Full Charge Damage: 250% of damage
Max Ammunition Capacity: 15 (<word_group=10106>max ammunition effects refresh after reloading</word_group>)
Additional Effect 1: Gains Pierce.
Additional Effect 2: Activates when performing a Full Charge attack. <word_group=10099>Expends ammo</word_group>. Amount: 40 round(s).
Additional Effect 3: Charge time is fixed at 1 sec.
Removal Condition: Reloading to max ammunition while in the Preparation for Change state.</color>
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Beauty-Full: Attack Damage ▲ 13.2% continuously.</color>
■ Activates upon reloading to max ammunition. Affects self.
<color=#00AEFF>Preparation for Change: Reload time is fixed at 3 sec for 6 sec. Removed upon firing the last bullet.</color>
■ Activates every 5 sec. Affects the enemy unit nearest to the crosshair.
<color=#00AEFF>Deals 450% of <word_group=10025>final</word_group> ATK as damage.</color>
■ Activates each time <word_group=10078>total ammo consumed by allies</word_group> reaches 200. Affects all allies.
<color=#00AEFF><word_group=10015>Fills Burst Gauge</word_group> by 7.09%.</color>

lines.text: Grave prepared this swimsuit especially for me. What do you think? Isn't it beautiful?
I knew it. I just look good in everything. You agree, don't you, Prince?
It's so sparkly. Absolutely perfect.
Prince, could you hold this for me while I change into my swimsuit?
Which do you like better? The white or the black?
I'm so glad I got to come to the beach with you, Prince.
Don't you think you've kept me waiting a little too long in this heat?
Don't worry about me and go on ahead. I'll try on some other swimsuits while you're gone.
I heard there's a place called a swimming pool. Take me to see it, Prince.
Look, Prince. Isn't my reflection in the mirror absolutely beautiful?
I really hope Grave wears a swimsuit next time too.
I'm glowing beneath the radiant sunlight. I truly am beautiful.
I feel lighter somehow.
Glass Slippers is gleaming.
If I get any more beautiful here, it could be a problem.
When did you have time to prepare this gift?
Did you prepare this for me? How thoughtful of you.
You always give me such beautiful gifts, Prince. Thank you.
You're beautiful yourself, Prince.
You know, I really enjoy being with you, Prince.
I could get used to spending time with you, Prince. That could be a problem.
Promise we'll be together even by the beach, Prince.
Yes? What's wrong?
Time to move with grace.
Let's finish this quickly.
I won't let anyone ruin our long-awaited vacation.
Don't worry, Prince. I'll protect you.
Let's wrap this up quickly and relax together.
Glass Slippers is sparkling today too.
I got all dirty. I'll have to change later.
Just a moment. Let me brush off this sand.
Shall we go, Prince?
Beautiful... Me, you, and the sea foam.
I'm going all out.
Don't get in my way.
Be gone.
How annoying.
Ugh.
Ngh.
What the...!
I didn't want anyone ruining our fun...
Come on, let's go enjoy the rest of our vacation, Prince.
